testcase.name: a fan with room needs no shift
no bounds means no shift for the edges, but controls are still cleared
when only some controls can be cleared, as many as possible are
a fan bigger than the window is centred on it and reported as not on screen
a control that cannot be cleared is left, on screen first
at every edge and corner the whole fan lands inside the bounds, moved no further than it must
on a phone in portrait the cluster, the legend and the chip row are all cleared at once
next to a control, on each of its sides, no touch square lands on it
the shifted fan keeps its shape - only the centre moves
